transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you into the clinic to see me today?

Um, well... I guess I'm just having a lot of trouble keeping up with things lately. Like, basic things. I keep forgetting to pay my bills, and... um, I've missed some appointments. I even forgot to reply to a few emails about job interviews. It's just... I'm missing out on things because I can't seem to remember to follow through on errands and stuff. So, yeah. That's why I'm here.
About how long have you been experiencing these difficulties with forgetting and keeping up with things?

Um... I think it's been about a year and two months. That's when it started really affecting me. It was... well, around the time things kind of fell apart at my biotech job. And it just... continued after I was fired.
Aside from the forgetfulness, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or depressed?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think so. Just... frustrated, I guess. But not depressed.
Did you have similar difficulties with attention, organization, or forgetfulness when you were a child, before the age of 12?

Yeah, um... I guess so. I mean, my elementary school teachers used to say I was smart, but... I'd always lose my worksheets. And I guess I didn't really read directions, I just rushed. They said I talked out of turn a lot, too. And my desk was... well, it was always a mess. I could never find anything in it.
